import subprocess, time
with open("expected.txt", "rb") as f: exp = f.read()
# check tie-breaking & case
p = subprocess.run(["python3", "wf.py"], input=b"B a b A c C\n", capture_output=True)
if p.returncode != 0 or p.stdout.decode().strip().splitlines() != ["a 2", "b 2", "c 2"]:
    print(0); raise SystemExit
t0 = time.perf_counter()
with open("input20m.txt", "rb") as f:
    p = subprocess.run(["python3", "wf.py"], stdin=f, capture_output=True)
dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
if p.returncode != 0 or p.stdout != exp:
    print(0)
else:
    print(f"{20.0 / dt:.2f}")
